response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, deep technical curiosity, and a track record of building scalable systems and open-source tools, but lacks explicit evidence of leading large-scale experimentation platforms, AI-driven growth systems, or cross-team instrumentation frameworks required for a Principal IC6 role.
strengths: Proven full-stack expertise across JavaScript/TypeScript, DLang, C++, and cloud tools with production scale experience.
Demonstrated ability to build and ship open-source infrastructure (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts) used by real-world teams.
Strong data and systems thinking evidenced by low-latency, high-throughput services and telemetry-adjacent work.
concerns: No clear evidence of designing or owning enterprise-grade experimentation or feature-flagging platforms.
Lacks documented leadership in cross-team growth measurement, rollout automation, or risk control systems.
Minimal mention of statistical analysis, bias detection, or AI-augmented engineering workflows central to the role.
